_notes.emotional_state_pruning: Suzanne's original 10-item emotional state battery reduced to 3 novel items not captured by the core SSS. Removed: energetic (SSS energy VAS), anxious/jittery (STAI tense+worried), tired (SSS energy + redundant with worn out), foggy/scattered (SSS clarity VAS), calm/relaxed (STAI calm+relaxed), clear/focused (SSS clarity VAS), tense/overwhelmed (STAI tense). Retained: worn out/weary (fatigue/depletion — novel), managing emotions well (emotion regulation — novel), burnout capacity (burnout proxy — novel).
_notes.tension_format: Tension battery uses VAS 0-100 (not Suzanne's original 4-point Likert). Suzanne explicitly deferred to Shiftwave's format. VAS gives finer granularity for somatic tracking and keeps data commensurable with all other SFI deployments. Her sentence stems preserved as question prompts.
_notes.tension_regions: 10 regions from Suzanne's document: jaw, chest/diaphragm, shoulders, neck/throat, back, hips/pelvis, stomach, head/temples, hands, feet.
_notes.3day_followup: 3-day follow-up timing not yet implemented in HTML. Acceptability item (sz_use_again) added to post as interim. Move to 3-day timing when that architecture is built.
_notes.pii: Email, phone, date require edge function changes. Not implemented.
_notes.comment_prompts: Suzanne uses different open-ended prompts per timepoint. Per-timing comment text requires HTML change — not yet implemented.
